effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux tests only; no native macOS/Windows protected execution proof.
effects.before: A protected Validate request could reach a phase-handler world before a matching protected effect route was proved.
effects.after: The bounded protected route refuses a nonempty Validate handler world before C1 reservation or process creation; ordinary default lifecycle remains separate.

effects.platform: One real GNU/Linux script effect and selected synthetic tests; native macOS/Windows interpreter behavior unrun.
effects.before: No fixed protected script Validate entry with exact nofollow source witness and per-run staged first effect.
effects.after: A crate-private fixed entry binds exact script bytes and host OS to the request/plan, publishes the source stage only after matching Ready/header, allows one counted process and inspects retained replay/partial outcomes without a second process.

effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux hosted-Parked fixture; no native macOS/Windows or provider-completion proof.
effects.before: No fixed protected agent Validate entry bound to an exact witnessed prompt and retained hosted task.
effects.after: A crate-private fixed entry binds the prompt/source, parks one hosted task after Ready, and replays the same Parked marker without another resolve or publication; its backend cannot complete a provider call.

effects.platform: Current-host check implemented for Linux/macOS/Windows enum; selected GNU/Linux refusal test only.
effects.before: A caller-supplied foreign target OS could be carried into the fixed script or agent entry without this pre-reservation equality check.
effects.after: Both fixed entries refuse when requested target OS differs from the current host before reservation; no cross-platform native execution is inferred.

user_impact.reason: Only crate-private fixed protected Validate routes and refusal boundaries change; ordinary lifecycle and public CLI/MCP are not routed through them, so existing 1.0.x user-owned state needs no migration.

documentation_impact.reason: Developer/release architecture guidance should describe the fixed script and hosted-Parked reservation/source-stage/replay boundary, and distinguish it from public or general handler support; final owned topic map remains pending.
